categories.name: Identity and provenance
categories.evidence: GIS FID 788 directly names Alpha Xi Delta at 519 University St; official Purdue chapter material and a dated 2008 house image corroborate identity.
categories.limitations: Auxiliary illustration is secondary; sources do not provide measured elevations.

categories.name: Plan geometry and placement
categories.evidence: 24-point ring; max source-to-root vertex error 0.00001569 m; saved bounds, area, perimeter, centroid, and PCA axis are closely matched.
categories.limitations: The source ring was used to construct the shell and uses an approximate local conversion; this is not independent placement or survey validation.

categories.name: Exterior silhouette and openings
categories.evidence: R2 closes the previously unsupported roof opening; the Tudor composition, gables, three dormers, windows, entry and brick/plaster division are visually readable.
categories.limitations: Roof planes/transitions remain broad and simplified; opening rhythm, height, dimensions and unseen elevations are not measured.

categories.name: Materials and facade
categories.evidence: Brick, ivory/cream plaster, dark timber, charcoal slate, trim and blue-gray glass form a coherent photo-supported palette.
categories.limitations: Procedural surfaces and facade details remain stylized.

categories.name: Interior and cutaway clarity
categories.evidence: The cutaway is explicitly captioned schematic/not as-built and shows partitions and furniture placeholders.
categories.limitations: Sparse schematic; no sourced floor plan, room count, functions or circulation verification.

categories.name: Presentation and technical
categories.evidence: Read-only Blender 5.2.3 open confirmed exact SHA, stable scene/collection/root, one scene/collection object, no cameras/lights, no external images.
categories.limitations: Independent geodetic placement was not checked.

remaining_limitations: Roof, height, window spacing, hidden elevations and interior are estimated or schematic.
GIS NUM_LEVELS=1 conflicts with the visible multi-level house; GIS Extrution=12 is undocumented and was not used as height.
Footprint agreement is by construction from the same ring and does not independently verify placement.
